name: Sarezuma no Koubutsu wa Musuko no Doukyuusei
original_name: サレ妻の好物は息子の同級生
source:
Minato goes through her daily life knowing her husband is cheating. She pretends not to notice for her child's sake, but she's nearing her limit emotionally.

The thought of having an affair herself crosses her mind. She turns her attention to other men, waits for some kind of spark - but there's nothing. Despair settles in: nothing she sees or does makes her heart flutter anymore.

And then her son's friend shows up at the door...

[Translated from the [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/772897]official site[/url]]
translation:
凑明知丈夫出轨，仍日复一日地生活着。为了孩子，她假装没有察觉，可情绪已经逼近极限。

自己也去出轨的念头，掠过脑海。她将目光转向其他男人，等待心动的火花，却一无所获。绝望逐渐笼罩她：无论看见什么、做些什么，都再也无法让她怦然心动。

就在这时，儿子的朋友出现在家门口…

[译自[url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/772897]官方网站[/url]]
